summary: Comprehensive Krea AI integration testing (backend + frontend) completed successfully. 22/22 pytest tests pass. Real end-to-end flow validated: generate (flux-1-dev) → poll → completed → save into project assets → image inserted into slide with pt-BR toast. Admin Integrations Health card renders correctly with 11 models available.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add a <DialogDescription> to the KreaPanel dialog for screen-reader compliance. Non-blocking.

krea-job-status text remained 'Status: scheduled' across several poll intervals before results appeared — status may not be updating from 'processing' before jumping to results. Not blocking; results still render correctly. Consider showing intermediate 'processing' state for better UX.

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription> to KreaPanel Dialog to resolve a11y console warning.
(Optional) Verify status update loop in KreaPanel transitions scheduled → processing → completed so users see live feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/krea.py: save-to-project endpoint re-calls krea_ai.get_job(job_id) even though the frontend may have already polled the completed job; minor extra hop, acceptable.

routes/krea.py: public_url uses env var BASE_URL fallback then relative path. Other Scormify assets use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/equivalent — confirm consistency so the saved <image> src resolves in SCORM export.
services/krea_ai.py: KREA_IMAGE_MODELS list is read at module import; adding a model requires backend reload. Acceptable for a curated list.
services/krea_ai.py: httpx client created per-call (30s/60s timeouts). For many concurrent calls, consider a shared AsyncClient. Non-blocking.

services/krea_ai.py: submit_generation clamps dims to model max but doesn't clamp minimum aspect or enforce Krea's own 64-multiple requirement — verify all 11 models accept 1024x576 etc. Only flux-1-dev was verified live.
seed_data_creation: One real Krea flux-1-dev job created (~$0.04 cost) and saved into project cd8a1146-ac15-49ad-9161-c3ba5cb3e830 assets folder. One MongoDB doc in db.krea_generations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Krea AI integration fully validated. Backend: 22 pytest tests green. Live Krea API verified — flux-1-dev completes in ~6s. Frontend: krea-ai-btn, krea-panel, krea-model-select (native <select> with 11 options), krea-prompt-input, krea-generate-btn, krea-job-status, krea-results, krea-save-0 all render. Admin Integrations Health card (integration-card-krea) shows 'Online / Saldo: 11 modelos de imagem disponiveis'. Aesthetics panel regenerate button (aesthetics-krea-regenerate) correctly hidden until 'Analisar Estetica' runs — not tested live since it requires an aesthetics analysis to populate first (that feature was already validated in prior iterations).
